name: kingdom
description: Multi-agent orchestration kit for Claude Code — parallel AI coding with Git worktrees and native cmux.app. A King (👑 Opus) coordinates generic workers (👷), co-workers (🧑‍💼), and watchmen (🕵️) — each in its own cmux.app workspace with role-coloured sidebar badges, native notifications, live state lines, and manual attention-badge overrides. Calibrated philosophy: 60% conservative core (human-gated push, mandatory kingdom merge, non-skippable gate) + 40% industrial overlay (auto-delegate big work, load idle capacity, parallel duplicate dispatch, watchman test-verification duty). Two-tier gate: light typecheck per-lane + heavy tests on kingdom branch (integration test environment). Three-tier UI hierarchy: Workspace per master, Tab for visible sub-agent spawns, Split for predefined dual-view. Model-tiered sub-agent spawn defaults. King reads ALL context at session start; uses watchman outputs at every decision point; auto-fires the pre-commit gate; ALWAYS merges into kingdom for review BEFORE asking 'push?'. Every per-task artifact carries the lane name for grep-friendly continuation. Workers are interchangeable capacity. Domain-agnostic: code, research, finance, science, manuscripts. Bootstrap with /kingdom:init; spawn with /kingdom:start; audit with /kingdom:update; close with /kingdom:exit. Won't touch your project files, develop/main branches, shell config, or git config.
